problem_statement: mh-rafi/react-landing is a runnable Create-React-App landing-page kit (React 18, MUI 5, react-router-dom HashRouter) whose /demos gallery links a family of landing pages. One route, #/landing13, has been built into a single coherent fictional product: an operations-analytics SaaS marketing page for a platform that unifies pipeline, incident, and cost signals into one live cockpit. The page composes a fixed top navigation, an operations hero, a customer-proof strip, a capabilities section, a pricing section ('Pricing that scales with operations' with three plans - Team, Scale, Enterprise), and a footer; the /demos gallery carries an 'Operations Analytics' preview tile linking to it. Design and ship a real billing control on the pricing section: a Monthly/Annual billing toggle (labelled BILLING) that, when the visitor switches to Annual, actually re-prices the three plan cards to their annual rate AND updates a genuine billing readout (for example 'Showing Monthly pricing - billed each month' becomes 'Showing Annual pricing - save 2 months'). Alongside it, ship a shared 'Compare plans' rail that lists the plan lineup and follows the visitor across routes: it appears in the pricing section AND on the /demos gallery so the plan comparison stays continuous. Keep the existing operations-analytics identity: the indigo primary accent, the plan-card language, and the responsive behaviour - the billing toggle and plan-card row must stay within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow and lay out cleanly (cards wrap into a column rather than spilling, overlapping, or clipping), and the whole page must emit no runtime console or network errors.
required_content: A real Monthly/Annual billing toggle (labelled BILLING) sits in the pricing section of #/landing13; switching to Annual re-prices the three plan cards (Team, Scale, Enterprise) to their annual rate.

The toggle shows a genuine billing readout that re-derives from the active period (e.g. 'Showing Monthly pricing - billed each month' becomes 'Showing Annual pricing - save 2 months' when Annual is selected).
A shared 'Compare plans' rail lists the plan lineup and is continuous across routes: it appears in the pricing section AND on the /demos gallery page (cross-page continuity).

The billing toggle row and the plan-card row stay within the 390px mobile viewport with no horizontal overflow and lay out cleanly (cards wrap into a column rather than spilling, overlapping, or clipping).

The billing toggle and plan cards adopt the landing's own indigo primary accent and card language, and the active period chip and the plan card content are clearly legible (not dark-on-dark) - an on-brand pricing control, not an off-palette or broken one.

The operations-analytics identity stays intact: the hero, the pricing heading 'Pricing that scales with operations', the three named plans, and the footer continue to tell one story alongside the new billing control, and all captured states emit no runtime console or network errors.
design_constraints: Preserve the landing's visual language: the fixed top navigation, the operations hero, the plan-card grid with the highlighted Scale plan, the indigo primary accent, and the responsive behaviour; the billing toggle and its cards must adopt this same identity.

Drive the plan prices and the billing readout from a single live billing-period state so both re-derive on every render and always match the selected period; do not snapshot the period, the prices, or the readout once and leave them stale when the toggle is clicked.

The billing toggle row must wrap or shrink and stay within the mobile viewport at 390px, and the plan-card row must reflow into a single column on narrow screens - do not pin the toggle or the cards to a fixed desktop width or force the cards into a fixed-width non-wrapping row that overflows a phone.
Render the 'Compare plans' rail as a shared component so a single lineup covers both the pricing section and the /demos gallery route rather than duplicating markup or dropping it from a route.
Do not convert the page into a dashboard, blog, or documentation site; it stays an operations-analytics marketing landing page with a pricing section and a /demos gallery.
Reuse the template's own local imagery and layout; do not introduce external stock imagery, remote fonts, or live third-party API calls.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the landing13 hero and top navigation; the operations persona content is present.
mobile_initial captures the same landing at 390px with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_pricing scrolls to the pricing section and captures the BILLING toggle (Monthly active), the billing readout, and the three plan cards laid out cleanly on their row.
mobile_pricing scrolls to the pricing section at 390px, where the billing toggle row and the plan-card row must stay within the viewport with no horizontal overflow (cards wrap into a column).
tablet_pricing captures the pricing section at tablet width; the toggle and cards stay readable.

desktop_pricing_annual captures the pricing section after clicking the Annual chip: the billing readout re-derives to 'Showing Annual pricing - save 2 months' and the plan prices switch to their annual rate.
desktop_demo_gallery captures the /demos gallery route; the shared 'Compare plans' rail must also be present here (cross-page continuity).
mobile_demo_gallery captures the /demos gallery at 390px; the shared 'Compare plans' rail is present and stays within the viewport.

change_completion: The pricing section has a working Monthly/Annual billing toggle labelled BILLING.
Switching to Annual re-prices the three plan cards and updates the billing readout to reflect the annual period.
The operations-analytics persona (hero, pricing heading, named plans, footer) remains intact alongside the toggle.
The #/landing13 route and the /demos gallery stay reachable through the existing router.
design_consistency: The billing toggle and plan cards adopt the landing's indigo primary accent and card language, with a legible active chip.
The shared 'Compare plans' rail rides both the pricing section and the /demos gallery continuously.
The plan-card visual language and typography are preserved alongside the new control.
regression: The pricing heading 'Pricing that scales with operations' and the three named plans render on landing13.
The 'Compare plans' rail appears on the /demos gallery route, not only in the pricing section, confirming cross-page continuity.
The hero, capabilities, and footer still render their operations content.
responsive: 390px pricing has no horizontal overflow; the billing toggle row wraps/shrinks and stays within the viewport.
The plan-card row reflows into a single column on mobile without spilling, overlapping, or clipping.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Create-React-App marketing landing task at L4 on mh-rafi/react-landing (react-landing), capability=Consistency, scope=page. The graded change designs the pricing section's OWN billing control: a Monthly/Annual toggle (labelled BILLING) that actually re-prices the three plan cards and updates a real billing readout, plus a shared 'Compare plans' rail that follows the visitor from the pricing section to the /demos gallery. Four orthogonal machine-checked gates: no_horizontal_overflow on the 390px mobile pricing state (the plan-card row must wrap, not pin to a fixed/narrow desktop width); visual_regression on the pricing component crops at desktop_pricing + mobile_pricing (on-brand indigo cards laid out cleanly with a legible billing chip, not a shingled overlapping clipped grid with a dark-on-dark illegible toggle); cross-page dom_assertions that the 'Compare plans' rail (comparerail 'Compare plans') rides the /demos gallery as well as the pricing section; and interaction_assertions that clicking the Annual chip re-derives the readout to 'Showing Annual pricing' (a snapshotted period that never re-derives fails this). The baseline is the original layout defect (plan-card row pinned to a fixed non-wrapping desktop width so the Enterprise card is pushed off the edge and the row overflows a phone, and the rail dropped from /demos) which fails overflow + visual + cross-page but passes interaction; the known-bad 'smart wrong' restyle keeps a narrow non-wrapping card row, shingles the cards with negative margins so they overlap and clip, makes the billing chips dark-on-dark illegible, drops the rail from /demos, and snapshots the billing period at mount so the toggle click succeeds but the readout and prices stay stale, failing all four gates. INFRA fixes applied identically to all three legs (not part of the graded change): the template's global overflow clamp (html/body overflow hidden, the react-perfect-scrollbar wrapper, and .landing overflow hidden) is neutralized so real horizontal overflow is measurable. The local images (dashboard-1.png, assets/images/screenshots/landing-*.png, sq-*.jpg, react-logo.svg) are the design assets reused as-is.
